jobs.description_text: At CesiumAstro, we are developers and pioneers of out-of-the-box communication systems for satellites, UAVs, launch vehicles, and other space and airborne platforms. In this role, you will be responsible for developing, implementing and leading the Company's integrated Trade Compliance Programme across Germany. The role provides strategic leadership for export controls, customs compliance, sanctions, import compliance, Free Trade Agreements (FTAs), product origin, customs valuation, duty optimisation, the EU Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM), and applicable U.S. extraterritorial export control requirements affecting European operations. Acting as the principal subject matter expert, the position ensures compliance with German, European Union, United States and other international trade regulations while enabling business growth across defence, aerospace, space, telecommunications and high-technology programmes. The role partners with Engineering, Programmes, Procurement, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Contracts, Finance, Legal and Executive Leadership

jobs.title: Account Manager, Programmatic
jobs.description_text: We are looking for a driven and client-focused Programmatic Account Manager to join our US National team. You will manage a portfolio of brand direct and agency clients across our US Central region, acting as their primary point of contact from campaign kickoff through quarterly business reviews. You will combine strong programmatic expertise with a performance-first mindset to deliver measurable results, uncover growth opportunities, and strengthen long-term partnerships. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, data-driven environment and is passionate about delivering impactful, client-centric solutions.

jobs.title: Credit Collection Specialist (1 Year Contract)
jobs.description_text: We are looking for a motivated and energetic candidate to join our Cash Collection and Treasury team. The role will focus mainly on cash collection, around 90% of the internship. Cash management tasks will represent around 10% and will be introduced gradually once the intern understands our processes, clients, and business environment. This is a hands-on role in a fast-paced ad tech environment. The intern will work closely with clients, Sales, and Finance teams to follow up on payments, reconcile accounts, and support process improvement projects, including AI and automation initiatives.

jobs.title: Demand Sales Manager, DACH
jobs.description_text: Building on the double digit growth of 2025 in EMEA the DACH sales team requires an ambitious Sales Manager looking to take the next step in their career. Equativ is a global end to end media platform with an advanced suite of products designed to fulfill the needs of advertisers and agencies at scale. Our product offering ranges from managed services (IO) to programmatic (PMPs, PG and curated marketplaces). The sales team are focused on driving conversations on Equativ’s media, targeting and buying solutions with agency and advertising partners. Including growing trends such as CTV. 👫 About the team The agency sales team is made of forward thinking and energetic online advertising experts that help bring Equativ’s programmatic and managed service solutions to market. They deliver revenue and build long-term relationships with our strategic agency partners, representing some of the largest players in the AdTech industry, guiding them to maximise their investment. The agency team is a critical component of driving Equativ adoption and shaping and driving growth for the DACH market. If you have experience of working with both agency holding groups and independent agencies and if you believe that you have what it takes to help deliver our growth ambitions, we would love to talk to you. What we are looking for: Proactive, diligent and energetic sales person with experience working within digital DACH media agencies with 3-6 years experience. The ability to build trust with your c

jobs.title: FP&A Manager
jobs.description_text: 👫 About the team Our Financial Planning and Analysis (FP&A) team is the primary Finance partner for Equativ’s business leaders. The team is composed of several FP&A professionals, based in Paris & Montreal, who strive to provide enterprise-wide planning, analysis and reporting. The team’s main mission is to provide visibility and counseling on the business not only to the executive team, but also to local business leaders. Real backbone of the company and highly visible, the FP&A team achieves this through measuring and forecasting performance, reporting on the drivers for revenue and cost and allocating budgets across the company in a fast growing and complex environment. The team’s input is also required for all finance projects: M&A growth, product pricing and billing implementation, contracts renegotiation, etc.

jobs.title: Key Account Manager
jobs.description_text: Equativ is one of the largest and most innovative independent advertising technology (ad tech) platforms globally. By joining our team, you will be part of a company that is transforming the digital advertising landscape, offering transparent and efficient solutions that connect advertisers and publishers. You will work in a dynamic, collaborative environment with cutting-edge technology, where you will own a portfolio of strategic accounts in LATAM and your talent will have a direct impact on the digital ecosystem. As Key Account Manager, you will be the single owner of your accounts across the full campaign lifecycle on Maestro, our curation and activation platform: from campaign creation and strategy setup, through optimization and support, to reporting and the presentation of results. You replace fragmented handoffs with true end-to-end account ownership.

jobs.title: Programmatic Customer Success Manager
jobs.description_text: About the Role We're looking for a Programmatic Customer Success professional to join our Curation team and help grow a book of partners across the digital advertising ecosystem, including agencies, curation providers, supply-side partners, retail and commerce media networks, and data providers. This isn't a support-oriented role. You'll own day-to-day relationships and troubleshooting, but you'll also learn to think like a growth partner: understanding what makes each partner tick, spotting opportunities to expand the relationship, and helping partners get more value out of Equativ's Maestro platform over time. You don't need to be an expert in every part of programmatic advertising. We're looking for someone who has some exposure to digital advertising or AdTech, is curious and eager to learn, and genuinely enjoys building relationships and solving problems. This is a great opportunity for someone early in their career who wants to build a foundation in programmatic advertising and curation, with room to grow into broader account ownership as our team and our partners' businesses scale. What You'll Do Own day-to-day relationships for a portfolio of partners, serving as a reliable point of contact for questions, requests, and troubleshooting. Help onboard new partners onto Maestro and ensure a smooth start to the relationship. Partner with internal teams (Product, Sales, Operations) to resolve issues and unblock partners quickly. jobs.title: Publisher Key Account Manager, Japan
jobs.description_text: About Equativ Founded in 2001 in Paris, Equativ has grown into a global independent ad tech platform enabling advertisers and media owners to achieve better business outcomes through programmatic, CTV, and retail media solutions. Backed by 750+ employees across 19 countries, Equativ combines global scale with privacy-first innovation About Equativ Japan KK Founded in February 2025, Equativ Japan K.K. is based at WeWork KDX Toranomon. Our team of eight reflects a diverse, multicultural environment, with English and Japanese as our primary working languages. We currently observe a work-from-home policy on Wednesdays, which will extend to both Wednesdays and Thursdays from September 1. Equativ Japan K.K. currently serves more than 20 premium publishers in Japan, including Kodansha, Shueisha, Hearst Fujingaho, Condé Nast, Sankei, Magazine House, Shogakukan, Yomiuri, and Asahi Shimbun, as well as broadcasters such as TBS and KTV. Our unique value proposition is rooted in a strong commitment to transparency, ensuring fair value for publishers while driving meaningful incremental premium demand. This is supported by deep expertise in high-growth formats, including mobile interscroller, CTV, gaming, and more.

jobs.title: Sales Director, Japan
jobs.description_text: Why Join Equativ? Be part of a fast-growing, independent ad tech leader with global reach and European roots with a team of more than 700 people in 20 offices. Work at the forefront of innovation creating a bespoke marketplace for luxury & tech Advertisers in Japan. Help create a more transparent, sustainable, and privacy-first advertising ecosystem. What’s in it for you? You will join Equativ at a key moment as we start our Japan operations and set up the founding team for the market. You will be a critical member to start our local demand-side business by taking onleading all sales activities and building the future of Equativ Japan!

jobs.title: Sales Enablement Manager - APAC/MENA
jobs.description_text: 👋 Hi! We are Equativ! Equativ is an AdTech leader created in 2001 on the belief that we can disrupt the on-line advertising industry. Headquartered in the heart of Paris and with offices in 19 countries, Equativ provides cutting-edge technologies that help hundreds of prestigious customers take back control and maximize their digital revenues with a flexible and transparent audience monetization platform. We can rely on a unique group of 700+ colleagues focused on excellence to shape our future. They continually embrace change and overcome challenges together to make innovation happen. That means we can offer you endless opportunities to do the same and let you shape the world you want! Equativ is looking for a proactive and strategic Sales Enablement Manager to join our Sales Enablement team. In this pivotal role, you will be the driving force behind our demand-side success across the APAC and MENA regions. You won't just be managing documents; you will be a key partner to our Sales teams, to plan, build, and continuously improve the collateral, tools and processes that help our sales teams win. By sitting at the intersection of Product, Sales, and Marketing, you will transform Equativ’s sophisticated tech capabilities into winning narratives that resonate with the world’s leading agencies and brands.

jobs.title: Sales Manager, Demand Partnerships
jobs.description_text: About the Role Equativ is looking for a driven and experienced Sales Manager to grow our managed advertising business across Latin America, with a primary focus on Mexico and key regional markets. This is a senior individual contributor role — you own your pipeline, your relationships, and your number. You will sell Equativ's full suite of managed solutions to a mix of media agencies and direct advertisers, positioning our ad tech platform as the partner of choice for premium digital advertising in the region. What You'll Do Own and exceed an individual revenue quota across Mexico and assigned LATAM markets. Develop and grow relationships with media agencies (GroupM, Publicis, Havas, IPG, Omnicom) and direct advertisers across key verticals. Drive the full sales cycle: prospecting, pitch, proposal, negotiation, and close. Collaborate with internal teams (AdOps, Account Management, Marketing) to ensure seamless campaign execution and client satisfaction. Identify upsell and cross-sell opportunities within existing accounts. Represent Equativ at industry events, trade shows, and client meetings across the region. jobs.title: Research Scientist
jobs.description_text: About the Institute of Foundation Models We are a dedicated research lab for building, understanding, using, and risk-managing foundation models. Our mandate is to advance research, nurture the next generation of AI builders, and drive transformative contributions to a knowledge-driven economy. As part of our team, you’ll have the opportunity to work on the core of cutting-edge foundation model training, alongside world-class researchers, data scientists, and engineers, tackling the most fundamental and impactful challenges in AI development. You will participate in the development of groundbreaking AI solutions that have the potential to reshape entire industries. Strategic and innovative problem-solving skills will be instrumental in establishing MBZUAI as a global hub for high-performance computing in deep learning, driving impactful discoveries that inspire the next generation of AI pioneers. The Role As a Research Scientist with a focus on data-centric large language model (LLM) development, your role will center on advancing the frontiers of how LLMs reason, retrieve, and interact with external information sources. You will proactively identify, collect, and organize datasets that enable LLMs to perform complex reasoning tasks, while also developing scalable systems and tooling that integrate cutting-edge research with robust engineering. Your work will have a direct impact on the performance and reliability of intelligent systems at MBZUAI IFM.

jobs.title: Enterprise Account Executive (EMEA)
jobs.description_text: Immuta is the Data Authorization Company, helping the world’s largest organizations control who, and what, can access their data. The way enterprises access data is fundamentally changing. Organizations are racing to put data to work across analytics and AI, while AI copilots and agents are emerging as an entirely new class of data consumer. Traditional approaches built around tickets, static permissions, and manual approvals were not designed for this speed, scale, or complexity. Immuta provides the authorization layer for modern data and AI. Our platform enables organizations to provision governed access to data by policy, by request, and dynamically for AI agents, so people and AI can access the data they need while enterprises maintain security, compliance, and control. For Chief Data Officers, that means making enterprise data dramatically easier to access and use without giving up governance. For AI leaders, it means giving AI agents secure, governed access to enterprise data so they can move from experimentation into production. Founded in 2015, Immuta is trusted by Fortune 500 companies and government agencies worldwide. Our technology ecosystem includes Snowflake, Databricks, AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud, Okta, ServiceNow, Teradata, Alation, Atlan, and Starburst — connecting Immuta to the data, cloud, identity, and enterprise platforms powering modern data and AI environments. Immuta has been recognized by Forbes as a top American startup employer, by Inc. Maga

jobs.description_text: Role Summary The Manager/Senior Manager, CMC Quality Control (QC) is responsible for providing strategic and operational oversight of QC activities supporting Lexeo's gene therapy programs. The individual will work closely with Analytical Development, Technical Operations, Regulatory Affairs, Quality Assurance, and external partners to ensure analytical methods, specifications, and testing programs support clinical development, process validation readiness, and future commercial requirements. This position requires technical expertise in analytical testing, preferably of AAV-based products, as well as demonstrated experience overseeing external laboratories and driving cross-functional CMC initiatives.

jobs.description_text: Role Summary This Research Associate (RA) will support the Analytical Development team of scientists to perform routine testing of samples and prepare for analytical assays designed for AAV-based gene therapy programs. This will include assisting with maintenance of cell cultures, performing proceduralized molecular assays (e.g., qPCR/ddPCR), and maintaining the laboratory space. This RA will also assist in supporting the daily operation and organization of the research laboratory. This role requires strong communication skills, the ability to multitask, and a willingness to adapt in a fast-paced environment.

jobs.description_text: Role Summary This Scientist II will independently design, execute, and analyze research studies and will drive one or more analytical development projects for AAV-based gene therapy programs. The role provides technical leadership in the development, optimization, qualification, validation, and transfer of analytical assays, including cell-based potency and molecular methods such as qPCR and ddPCR. The Scientist II will apply broad scientific knowledge and novel approaches to establish AAV mechanisms of action in cellular systems, resolve moderately complex technical issues, and support GMP manufacturing, material release, and regulatory submissions in collaboration with groups across CMC, Quality, QC, and external partners. The ideal candidate is highly collaborative, detail-oriented, able to manage multiple priorities, and effective in a fast-paced environment. The Scientist II is expected to exercise sound scientific judgment, communicate complex technical issues clearly, build alignment across functions, and serve as a technical resource to colleagues. This is a highly visible and impactful role in our CMC organization.

jobs.title: OSINT Analyst - Vessel Identification
jobs.description_text: Automated detection can find vessels, but cannot always tell you which vessel it is. When a contact appears in a satellite image with no matching AIS, when an identity has been spoofed or duplicated, when a name and IMO do not agree, or when the models simply return low confidence, a human analyst has to resolve it. As an OSINT Analyst on Kpler's Maritime Domain Awareness team, you are the adjudication layer behind the machine. You take the detections that automated identification cannot confidently resolve and attach an identity to them: name, IMO, owner, operator, and flag, with the evidence and the confidence to stand behind it. You investigate dark vessels, AIS gaps, GNSS spoofing, and identity manipulation, and you reconstruct the ownership and behaviour that explains what a vessel is really doing. Your work does two things at once. It makes Kpler's unified vessel record more complete and more trusted for the analysts, compliance desks, and government users who depend on it. And it creates the labelled ground truth that makes the detection models better, so the routine cases keep shrinking and human attention stays on the genuinely hard ones.

jobs.title: Research Scientist
jobs.description_text: Do you believe the path to general-purpose physical AI runs through noisy, real-world factory deployments? Are you excited by the challenge of turning the classical robotic stacks into the foundational training data for physical AI? Do you want to bridge the gap between world-class ML research and industrial-scale robotic execution? If your answers are yes, we should talk. At Nomagic, we are executing a humble pivot for general-purpose physical AI. We believe that physical AI is fundamentally a knowledge transfer problem - we are leveraging the "internet data" of robotics - massive deployment logs from real systems operating in production environments - to bootstrap our efforts. We are looking for Research Scientists who will help us to build, train, and deploy foundational models that bring our fleet from a classical control stack to generalized AI mastery.

jobs.title: Ambasciatore Octopus Energy

In Octopus Energy lo facciamo già ogni giorno: rendiamo l'energia più equa, pulita e accessibile grazie alla tecnologia. jobs.title: Asset Management Operations Director
jobs.description_text: Help us make a big green dent in the universe. We're on a mission to drive the global renewable energy revolution, and we need many more people to help us make our vision a reality. Octopus Energy Generation (OEGEN) is a leader in sourcing, investing in, and managing a wide range of utility-scale renewable energy assets. As we continue to expand our investment base, we are dedicated to building a diverse team that reflects the communities we serve. Currently, we manage a global portfolio of over £8 billion in renewable energy assets. We are committed to delivering best-in-class responsible investment activity, offering like-minded investors the means and products to invest their capital sustainably. It is our ambition to change the entire energy lifecycle and make every green electron matter, delivering the best outcomes for customers, investors, the environment and society, accelerating the transition to net zero. About this role: We are looking for an AM Operations Director to build the operating structure around Asset Management as OEGEN continues to grow and manage increasingly complex assets. The role is about making sure the basics are done well and consistently, without problems repeatedly needing senior intervention. It will take ownership of important work that cuts across funds and functions, where standards already exist but are not consistently embedded, or where there is currently no clear owner. In Octopus Energy lo facciamo già ogni giorno: rendiamo l'energia più equa, pulita e accessibile grazie alla tecnologia. Presenti in Italia dal 2022, siamo partiti da Ascoli Piceno, dove abbiamo la nostra sede. jobs.title: Capital Markets Analyst
jobs.description_text: What we do. Electric Car Leasing Why we do it. Greener. Fairer. Future. We are a market-leading, mission-driven organisation focused on accelerating the transition to a net-zero economy through innovative financing solutions. As we enter a significant period of growth, we are scaling our Capital Markets team to support our increasingly sophisticated funding requirements. This is a high-growth opportunity for an analytical professional looking to build a career in Capital Markets. Joining as an Analyst, you will gain hands-on exposure to complex debt facilities and see the full lifecycle of a securitisation facility. You won't just be processing data; you will be learning how to structure and manage the capital which fuels a rapidly expanding leasing business.

jobs.title: Chief of Staff (m/w/d)
jobs.description_text: Als global tätiges EnerTech-Unternehmen verbinden wir Energieversorgung, Technologie und Services. Unser Ziel ist es, mehr Menschen Zugang zu modernen Energielösungen zu ermöglichen. Dafür bieten wir Stromtarife aus 100% erneuerbaren Energien an, installieren Wärmepumpen und entwickeln smarte Tarife. Dabei sind unsere Ökostromtarife nur die Basis. Bereits seit 2022 installieren wir Wärmepumpen-Komplettlösungen mit eigenen Fachkräften. Außerdem arbeiten wir aktiv an der flächendeckenden Einführung von Smart Metern, Elektromobilitätslösungen und der eigenen Stromerzeugung aus Wind- und Sonnenenergie. Das schaffen wir allerdings nicht alleine, sondern dazu brauchen wir dich! Werde Teil unseres Teams und fordere den Status Quo heraus. Mit Energie, die gut für den Planeten ist und gut für dein Karma. 💚 Finde jetzt deinen Traumjob und werde Teil der Energierevolution von Octopus Energy Germany. Business Development, Strategie, Projektmanagement – und das alles am liebsten gleichzeitig? Dann suchen wir genau dich. Als Chief of Staff (m/w/d) wirst du zur rechten Hand unserer CFO und zum Motor abteilungsübergreifender Projekte. Kein Tag wie der andere, kein Problem zu groß.

jobs.title: Commercial Analyst
jobs.description_text: About Octopus Electroverse We’re making electric vehicle public charging simple by building the giant, virtual charging platform of the future. In just five years, Octopus Electroverse has grown to become Europe’s largest eMSP public charging network, with over 1.4 million connected electric vehicle chargers globally across 79 countries. Naturally, we’re now taking this success beyond individual consumer drivers and scaling our dedicated B2B proposition - Octopus Fleet - to help businesses transition to zero-emission transport with ease. From EV public charging cards to home charging reimbursement, we are building the ultimate all-in-one suite to simplify fleet electrification. Electroverse and Octopus Fleet operate as a unified, cross-functional team across product, commercial, operations, marketing, and partnerships - all sharing a passion for shifting the industry toward EVs. As our commercial pipeline expands across high-value enterprise deals and complex formal tenders, we are looking for a sharp, structured, and analytical individual to build out and professionalise our bid engine. Reporting into the Commercial Strategy Manager, your focus will be on transitioning our tender process from a decentralised team effort into a streamlined, high-winning commercial capability.

jobs.title: Commercial Director (m/w/d)
jobs.description_text: Wer wir sind Octopus Energy ist eines der am schnellsten wachsenden Energieunternehmen Europas. In Deutschland versorgen wir über eine Million Kunden mit günstiger, grüner Energie und wachsen weiter. Wir denken Energie neu: tech-driven, kundenzentriert, agil. Unser Team in Deutschland arbeitet mit der Geschwindigkeit eines Scale-ups und der Ambition, den deutschen Energiemarkt grundlegend zu verändern. Die Rolle Wir bündeln unsere kommerziellen Bereiche unter einer Führung, um die nächste Wachstumsphase zu treiben. Als Commercial Director verantwortest du unsere gesamte kommerzielle Strategie, von Vertriebskanälen über Kundenbindung bis hin zu Produktentwicklung und Partnerschaften. Du bist Teil unseres Senior Management Teams und arbeitest direkt mit CEO und CFO an der strategischen Steuerung des Unternehmens.

jobs.title: Couvreur·euse
jobs.description_text: 🐙 Rejoins la révolution énergétique chez Octopus Energy ! Octopus Energy, fournisseur d’énergie verte présent à l’international, a lancé sa filiale Octopus Energy Services pour accompagner ses clients dans la décarbonation complète de leur foyer. Déjà bien implantée au Royaume-Uni, cette entité propose un ensemble de solutions techniques : installation de panneaux photovoltaïques, de bornes de recharge pour véhicules électriques et de systèmes de chauffage décarboné, le tout avec une approche centrée sur la qualité, l’innovation et sans sous-traitance. Tu veux un job qui a du sens ? Octopus Energy Services a démarré son activité en 2024, avec un objectif clair : aider les particuliers à réduire leurs factures énergétiques tout en participant activement à la transition énergétique. Et aujourd’hui on a besoin de toi pour propulser notre croissance !

jobs.description_text: 宇宙に「緑」の大穴をあけるために、力を貸してください！ 世界中で再生可能エネルギー革命を推進するミッションを実現するため、より多くの人の協力が必要なのです。 ＜ご応募の際は日本語の職務経歴書をご提出ください＞ 年次有給休暇23日／東京ガスと英国オクトパスエナジーの合弁会社 わたしたちは「グリーンな電力」をお手頃価格で提供地球に優しいグリーンな電力を手頃な価格で提供する会社です。 近年世界中で注目の「再生可能エネルギー」を日本にも普及させるため、2021年に東京ガスと電力会社オクトパスエナジーが共同出資して誕生しました。 ＜わたしたちはこういう会社です＞ ・出社と同時に自分の個性を包み隠さなくてはならないような職場ではなく、本来の自分でいられるような会社にしたい。なぜならその人物こそが我々が採用した人であり、ありのままの自分で同僚とやりとりしたり、お客様の応対をしてほしいから。その人の本質を尊重し、ありのままの自分で居られて、自ら創造性を高めて仕事に大いに貢献してもらえるような会社でありたい。そのためにも、社員がインスパイアされモチベーションを高められリラックスできる空間と合わせて、世界中の方々をお迎えする空間作りを行っている。 ・オクトパスの原理は、昔の建築の石垣の原理。つまり、２つと無いユニークな形の自然石同士の合わせの良さで強度を持たせて、何千年も持ち堪えることができる仕組みを大事にしている。だからこそありのままの自分を出してほしい。 ・自由と責任は比例する。みなさんには自由を持って働いてほしい。ソファに体をうずめて脚を投げ出した格好で仕事をしても良いし、好きな音楽を聴きながらでもいいし、服装も完全自由。休暇の申請も妥当なタイミングで良い。出勤退勤の打刻も必要無い。就業規則は最小限の内容。ただし自由には責任が伴う。自由と適切なプレッシャーを同時に味わいながら、常に昨日の自分よりも成長してほしいし邁進してほしい。 ・負荷をかけるというと、大企業では「苦手なことをさせる」場合が多いが、オクトパスでは皆が得意分野に取り組んで、オリジナリティを活かす。それこそが組織の強靭化につながる。なので、ITがやりたいならITを、営業なら営業、企画なら企画、好きなことで最大限あなたの力を活かしてほしい。そしていま私たちは、カスタマーサービスがやりたい人を探している。 ・ミスは表彰する。ミスが起きたとき、ミスをミスと認めることが肝要。そしてそれを責めず、寛容さをもって受け入れる。時には表彰して茶化す(笑)。皆が皆理由があってここにいるのだから、皆で支え合うのが当たり前。

Buscamos a una persona con una combinación especial: creatividad para idear experiencias diferenciales y, al mismo tiempo, capacidad para llevarlas a la práctica de principio a fin. jobs.description_text: Want a soul-sucking call centre job? Yeah, neither do we. We’re not here to read scripts or tick boxes. jobs.title: Dialoger*in / Fundraiser*in (m/w/d) Dein Upgrade: Festanstellung
jobs.description_text: Gutes Geld verdienen und trotzdem gut schlafen? Du willst keinen Sales-Job, bei dem du dich jeden Tag aufs Neue überwinden musst, hinter deinem Produkt zu stehen? Du willst Menschen begeistern, gute Gespräche führen und dabei richtig gutes Geld verdienen? Dann könnte das hier dein nächster Sales-Job sein. Face-to-Face Sales mit echtem Mehrwert Bei Octopus Energy sprichst du Menschendirekt am Point of Sale an und begeisterst sie für erneuerbare Energie. Du erkennst, was sie brauchen, beantwortest ihre Fragen und zeigst ihnen, welches Angebot zu ihnen passt. Kein Klinkenputzen, keine kalten Füße und kein Verkauf um jeden Preis: Du arbeitest warm und trocken in gut besuchten Einkaufscentern – gemeinsam mit deinem Team und mit einem Produkt, hinter dem du stehen kannst. Was du davon hast? 3.000–4.000 € brutto monatlich durch sicheres Fixgehalt und ungedeckelte Provision – deine Leistung zahlt sich aus. Dazu kommen 30 Tage Urlaub, ein unbefristeter Vertrag und jede Menge Benefits. Du kannst Sales. Wir geben dir ein Produkt mit Purpose dazu.

jobs.title: Director - Forecasting
jobs.description_text: Octopus Energy started with a bold idea: to build Britain’s first truly digital energy supplier. By combining world-class tech with brilliant humans who care deeply about customers and driving the renewable energy transition, we made it happen and in 2025, we became Britain’s largest energy supplier. We now serve over 12 million customers globally, are present in over 30 countries and manage a £7 billion portfolio of renewable energy assets. At Octopus, we prioritise generalists over specialists because our growth isn't limited to just one sector. We built Kraken into a £10B SaaS powerhouse, and are scaling ventures across Tech, Flexibility and Smart Heating among others. We are now looking to take our experience to new countries around the world. We are looking for someone to lead the build out forecasting and asset optimisation analytics in a new market for Octopus in East Asia. The role will cover forecasting price, generation and demand outturns. This will start off with a contained number of pilot projects to prove out the concept, but will expand to a national, multi-province approach. We envisage you spending a couple of months in Octopus HQ to get up to speed before deploying in country. This is a rare opportunity to create, build and lead a new function, targeting one of the largest opportunities in global energy.

jobs.title: Electrician - Wales
jobs.description_text: Help us make a big green dent in the universe. We're on a mission to drive the global renewable energy revolution, and we need loads more people to help us make our vision a reality. We're on a mission to drive the global renewable energy revolution, and we need loads more people to turn our vision into a reality. We’re keen for you to shine in your role so, based on your experience, you could be fitting any of our awesome low carbon tech - Electric Vehicle charge points, Air Source Heat Pumps or Solar! We’re recruiting across England so you’ll see lots of vacancies in lots of locations. Please only apply to the role and location that is most suitable for you. Please don’t apply to multiple locations. What you’ll do As part of the Octopus Energy Services team, we’ll ensure you have the best of everything you need to deliver the top-class service we’re aiming for. You’ll have the backing of Octopus Energy’s massive tech power - so we’ll be able to constantly evolve and shift processes to ensure we’re always delivering our best service. This should help to keep admin to a minimum, allowing you to focus on what you do best. Who you are We're looking for Electricians with a proven track record of safety and customer excellence. You’ll be representing our brands in our customers’ homes; in many cases, the first face-to-face contact a customer has with Octopus Energy - so our expectations are high.

jobs.title: Electricien·e
jobs.description_text: 🐙 Rejoins la révolution énergétique chez Octopus Energy ! Octopus Energy, fournisseur d’énergie verte présent à l’international, a lancé sa filiale Octopus Energy Services pour accompagner ses clients dans la décarbonation complète de leur foyer. Déjà bien implantée au Royaume-Uni, cette entité propose un ensemble de solutions techniques : installation de panneaux photovoltaïques, de bornes de recharge pour véhicules électriques et de systèmes de chauffage décarboné, le tout avec une approche centrée sur la qualité, l’innovation et sans sous-traitance. Tu veux un job qui a du sens ? Octopus Energy Services a démarré son activité en 2024, avec un objectif clair : aider les particuliers à réduire leurs factures énergétiques tout en participant activement à la transition énergétique. Et aujourd’hui on a besoin de toi pour propulser notre croissance !

jobs.title: Energy Specialist - Customer Support
jobs.description_text: Welcome to the future of energy Octopus is a tech-powered energy company. We believe technology has the power to address our greatest challenge, climate change, while also delivering incredible service and customer experience. We are changing the way people interact with their energy company - by making it approachable, low cost, easy-to-understand, and most importantly, 100% renewable. Want to work in a soul-destroying customer service call center? Don’t apply here. We’re a bit different... You won’t believe it until you actually start working here. We try to explain it during the application and interview process but really, until you’re immersed in our culture, you’ll realize you’ve never worked anywhere like it. At Octopus you’re not a number. You're a human and we treat you like one. And that’s how we want our customers to feel too. We want you to help our customers - like genuinely help. Like out of the box, what can I do here to make a difference to this customer, help? Crazy huh? You’ll chat to customers over the phone and via email while being given the freedom to help them in a way you too would like to be helped. You’ll take ownership of their needs and find a way, no matter what, to figure things out with them. We treat all of our customers like our grannies, (No offense intended - we really love our grannies) - with patience, kindness and warmth. That means you'll get real ownership over shaping how we sell it, with loads of room to grow as the product (and your career) matures. jobs.description_text: What we do. Electric Car Leasing Why we do it. Greener. Fairer. Future. This would suit someone with strong hands-on performance marketing experience, perhaps from an agency or fast-paced in-house environment, who wants more ownership, more visibility and more opportunity to influence what happens next.

jobs.title: We’re always on the lookout for brilliant humans
jobs.description_text: At Octopus Energy, we don’t just do traditional job specs. We don’t love rigid job titles. And we don’t believe that great people only come along when you happen to have a “vacancy”. We’re building something big - tech that transforms whole industries, teams that reimagine what brilliant looks like and products that people and customers actually love. That means our talent team are always open to meeting and speaking with exceptional humans who are passionate to help us do more of that. Maybe you’ve run big teams and we don’t mean just managing FTEs - you’ll happily work with no direct reports, because your enthusiasm means awesome people will follow you, and you’ll get stuff done. Maybe you’ve shaped strategy, launched products, scaled operations or quietly turned chaos into clarity. Maybe you’ve done the big jobs but you’re still hungry to build something meaningful. You probably don’t need a manager to tell you what needs doing. You spot the gaps and get stuck in. We don’t work to backlogs, we don’t write business cases but we prioritise effectiveness and efficiency above all else. We expect accountability without process, and responsibility without functional shoulder pads. We get stuff done by knowing what’s right and sometimes that’s hard. We don’t care what your last job title was. We care that you’ve got real experience a sharp instinct for what matters and a bit of fire in your belly to use it for something good. jobs.title: Women in Field Sales: Venue Sales Rep
jobs.description_text: Supporting women in field sales in the energy industry: At Octopus Energy, we’re on a mission to make energy fair, clean, and simple for all using technology. To get there, we need brilliant people with different backgrounds, experiences and perspectives helping us change the industry. Women account for 49% of full time employees in UK sales and customer focused jobs, yet they remain underrepresented in many commercial and field based roles. In field sales roles women only make up around 40% of roles in the UK and 29% in senior commercial roles, which is about 1 in 4 roles. We want to help change that by creating a field sales environment where women can build confidence, grow their careers and progress into leadership. We’re looking for incredible women across the UK to join our team as Venue Sales Representatives. Forget traditional field sales! We’re reinventing customer interactions and showing people that talking about energy can be engaging, helpful and fun! You’ll be one of the friendly faces of Octopus Energy, meeting customers in well known venues across the UK. You’ll start genuine conversations, explain what makes Octopus different and help people make energy choices that work for them and the planet. You don't need to know everything about energy or sales. We’ll give you the training, support and tools you need to thrive.
